_readme: Calibration sets (COLLECTION.md §4), pre-registered 2026-09-03 BEFORE the base build
(PRO-64 Phase 1). `membership` is the trap set: 14 trues across eras and 15 falses
(13F-only public names, Thrive Holdings and Eternal entities, the namesake filers,
ex-partner next-firm seats, personal seats, homonyms). Keys are document-anchored:
the firm's own fund Form Ds and ADV Section 7.B roster (local bulk zips + the
2026-07-06 ADV), the 2026-06-30 13F table, or a press citation. Gate: zero false
members at high confidence before any verdict writes; structural falses (no partner
seat, namesake filers) must have NO published base row. `stage` is the entry-stage
golden set, keyed to external documents before the blind pass; slugs are the
expected built rendering and are reconciled to the build (a slug is not a label).
Skips, deliberately unkeyed: SpaceX (secondary entry at a $38B valuation, year
uncitable), Spotify (secondary, year uncitable), Harry's (Mammoth Brands)
(round label unverified) — resolved in the grind, never guessed here.

Key correction before the build (2026-09-03): the ex-partner false was first keyed on Doji Labs, but its only Form D is 2025q3 — after Grimshaw rejoined Thrive (March 2024) — and Doji is on the firm's own job board; the seat is Thrive's, so Doji is a member and the false moved to Chrono (Paik's Pace-era seats, 2019q4/2022q4). Recorded here rather than silently.

_stage_readme: PRO-64 stage golden set: 35 rows keyed to external documents (press naming the round and Thrive's participation, the firm's own fund vehicles, Form D seats) BEFORE the blind pass. Growth-heavy by design (20 Growth / 10 Series A / 5 Seed): the book is secondaries, tenders and late primaries. Skims is the deliberate label-follows-record row; Oscar is the incubation row (Seed = the Claremount TW founding vehicle); Cadre is keyed to its documented Series A; Figma and Cadre are the two low-confidence keys, marked. The Form D band is expected to fail on the lettered SPVs (a $23.7M VIII Growth-D or a $450M X Growth-A sold amount is a vehicle size, not a round) — the gate scores it before the grind trusts it.
